reason: A read-only diagnostic tool that statically checks DSH plugin repositories for manifest, patch, build-configuration, ecosystem-compliance, and hub-catalog issues, then reports findings and suggested fixes.

summaries.zh: 一个只读检查 DSH 插件仓库清单、补丁格式、构建配置、生态合规性和 Hub 收录状态并生成诊断报告的工具。
summaries.en: A read-only tool that checks DSH plugin repositories for manifest, patch-format, build-configuration, ecosystem-compliance, and hub-catalog issues and generates diagnostic reports.

capabilities: Reads plugin repository directories and files for static checks
Scans plugin manifests, patch data, source configuration, and documentation
Optionally reads a public hub catalog through the gh command
Produces JSON compliance reports and repair suggestions without modifying or building the inspected repository
